title: NTU AI-for-X Postdoctoral Fellowship

compensation.value: SGD 250,000 research grant, up to 4 years of funding
compensation.evidence_quote: up to 4 years of funding, competitive remuneration and benefits, SGD 250,000 research grant

about: NTU's AI-for-X Postdoctoral Fellowship funds early-career STEM researchers whose proposals integrate AI to solve a scientific problem. It offers up to four years of funding and a research grant; applicants need an NTU faculty mentor and must start by 31 March 2027.
requirements: PhD in a STEM field conferred in 2023 or later
NTU faculty member as Project Mentor

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI I
why: "AI applied to scientific problems (STEM)" (field) → "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling"
"proposals integrate AI to solve a scientific problem" (description) → "Healthcare: diagnostic imaging, drug discovery, genomics, clinical decision support"

card_alt: Card for the NTU AI-for-X Postdoctoral Fellowship at Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore, with a deadline of 30 Oct 2026. The photo shows Marina Bay Sands and Gardens by the Bay.
